title: Uwell Viscore Neo 6K Prefilled Pod Kit
description: The Uwell Viscore Neo Prefilled Pod Kit is an advanced, stylish and highly adaptable device designed for vapers who value consistent performance and flexibility. Constructed from premium, durable materials, this kit features a substantial 1000mAh built-in battery capable of delivering up to 16W of reliable power. Designed to accommodate different usage needs, the Viscore Neo is fully compatible with two distinct pod formats, allowing you to choose between 6K and 12K puff configurations*. The true innovation of the Viscore Neo lies in its dual pod compatibility. You can pair the battery with either the 6K Edition (a 2ml pod plus a 4ml refill container) or the 12K Edition (a 2ml pod plus a 10ml refill container). Both options come prefilled with premium 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and feature an integrated 0.8ohm mesh coil. This setup guarantees rapid, even heating for a consistently smooth and flavourful Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw. Under the hood is Uwell’s smart battery tech and a display that provides clear, at-a-glance monitoring of your remaining charge, ensuring you always know when it is time to plug in. When a recharge is required, the Type-C port facilitates rapid power delivery to minimise your downtime. The device also utilises a transparent pod design, making it incredibly easy to keep track of your e-liquid levels throughout the day and prevent dry hits. The Uwell Viscore Neo Prefilled Pod Kit is available in 16 diverse premium flavours, each available in separate 2ml+4ml pod refills. Available Flavour Editions: Blueberry Sour Raspberry - A balanced fruit profile contrasting sweet, mellow Blueberry with a sharp, tangy Sour Raspberry finish. Milky Strawberry - A smooth, dessert-inspired blend pairing sweet Strawberry with a rich, creamy milk base. Pineapple Ice - The bright, tangy sweetness of exotic Pineapple finished with a brisk and cooling Menthol exhale. Watermelon Ice - A clean, subtly sweet vape inspired by ripe Watermelon, finished with a crisp, cooling chill. Lemon & Lime - A zesty, citrus-forward mix pairing tart Lemon with sharp, refreshing Lime. Fruit Mix - A complex and vibrant medley of sweet, juicy, and tangy mixed fruit flavours. Mr Blue - A rich berry blend combining dark Blackberry, punchy Raspberry, and sweet Blueberry with a frosty ice finish. Fresh Mint - A straightforward, brisk cooling experience with clean, botanical Mint notes from inhale to exhale. Huba Huba - A nostalgic, confectionery-inspired profile capturing the sweet, familiar taste of classic bubblegum. Orange-Bru - A beverage-inspired blend delivering the sweet, tangy, and slightly sparkling taste of classic orange soda. Sakura Grape - A unique pairing that blends the deep, juicy taste of dark Grape with light, botanical cherry blossom notes. Blue Sour Lemonade - A bright, sparkling fusion of tart Blue Raspberry and a zesty, citrus-forward Lemonade base. Blue Sour Peach - A dynamic fruit blend contrasting sharp, tangy Blue Raspberry with the soft, juicy sweetness of Peach. Blue Sour Black Currant - A rich, dark berry mix balancing tangy Blue Raspberry with deep, jammy Blackcurrant notes. Strawberry Kiwi - A classic, well-rounded pairing of sweet, sun-ripened Strawberry and sharp, exotic Kiwi. Cherry Blast - A bold, robust fruit profile focusing entirely on the deep, slightly tart essence of dark Cherry. How to Set Up Your Uwell Viscore Neo Kit: 1. Remove the 4ml or 10ml refill container from the top of the packaging. 2. Remove the red silicone plug located on the top of the 2ml prefilled pod. 3. Insert the refill container into the 2ml prefilled pod smoothly until it is assembled in place. 4. Insert the fully assembled unit into your device and inhale to vape. Note: We recommend waiting a few minutes after assembly to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the mesh coil before taking your first draw. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
